speaker: left
name: Count Down
text: Little duckling, I am almost pleased to see you.

speaker: left
name: Count Down
text: You bring me down feathers, but there are more out there still.

speaker: left
name: Count Down
text: What do you necessitate to continue making progress?

speaker: right
name: Goose
text: It would be good to be able to wall climb, I guess?

speaker: left
name: Count Down
text: Peck a wall, your beak will become an anchor and you can hold the S key to charge a flick upwards.

speaker: left
name: Count Down
text: It is a trait inherited through the Down family line for generations. Now off with you!
